svg.title: Japan · cultures, courts and shogunates
svg.desc: Selected, sourced connections. Arrows label unions, divisions, conquest, independence, changes in rule, and contact. Node positions do not measure time or ancestry. Archaeological periods are not states, and courts and shogunates could coexist. Cross-map Japanese expansion and Korea appear in Korea’s map. Select a node for Wikipedia or an arrow for its sources.
svg.text: Tap a node to read · Tap an arrow for the event and sources
